description: This file defines the ECRPublicClient class in the Aws\ECRPublic namespace. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method signatures for interacting with the Amazon Elastic Container Registry Public service, including methods for managing repositories, images, and registry data, as well as asynchronous versions of these methods.

classes.name: ECRPublicClient
classes.description: The client class for Amazon ECR Public, providing method signatures for each API operation.

methods.name: batchCheckLayerAvailability
methods.description: Checks the availability of image layers in the registry.

methods.name: batchDeleteImage
methods.description: Deletes specified images from the registry.

methods.name: describeImageTags
methods.description: Describes image tags within a repository.

methods.name: getAuthorizationToken
methods.description: Retrieves a token that can be used to authenticate to the registry.

methods.name: getRepositoryCatalogData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about a specific repository.

methods.name: getRepositoryPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the policy of a repository.

methods.name: uploadLayerPart
methods.description: Uploads a part of a layer.
